ciSteps.name: Materialize exact SDL source for actual input consumer tests
ciSteps.run:
set -euo pipefail
# 只取deps.lock的源commit供git archive/完整SDK宿主测试，不编译OHOS .so。
python -B <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
from lib.workspace_paths import external_output_path
section = re.search(r'^\[sdl3-native\]\s*\n([\s\S]*?)(?=^\[|\Z)', Path('deps.lock').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), re.M).group(1)
def field(name):
    return re.search(r'^' + name + r'\s*=\s*([^\s#]+)', section, re.M).group(1)
commit, repository = field('commit'), field('repo')
if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', commit) or not re.fullmatch(r'https://github.com/[^/]+/SDL.git', repository):
    raise ValueError('Invalid exact SDL test source pin')
source = external_output_path(os.environ['AMCL_SDL_TEST_REPO'])
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', str(source)], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(source), 'fetch', '--depth', '1', repository, commit], check=True)
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(source), 'checkout', '--detach', 'FETCH_HEAD'], check=True)
actual = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(source), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip()
if actual != commit:
    raise ValueError('SDL test checkout does not match deps.lock')
print('Exact SDL source ready:', actual)
PY

ciSteps.name: Verify JDK 17 release info SoT
ciSteps.run:
set -e
# 实际 JDK 产物存在 mc-ohos-resources Release（运行时下载）；
# 主仓只保留 release-info SoT。这里校验 deps.lock 段非空。
# （详细一致性校验在下一个 step "deps.lock vs JdkManager / Constants"）
for k in tag asset sizeBytes sha256; do
  v=$(awk -v key="$k" '
    /^\[mc-ohos-resources\]/ { f=1; next }
    /^\[/ { f=0 }
    f && $1==key && $2=="=" { $1=""; $2=""; sub(/^[ \t]+/,""); sub(/[ \t]*#.*$/,""); sub(/[ \t]+$/,""); print; exit }
  ' deps.lock)
  if [ -z "$v" ] || [ "$v" = "PENDING" ]; then
    echo "::error::deps.lock [mc-ohos-resources].$k is empty or PENDING"
    exit 1
  fi
done
echo "JDK 17 mc-ohos-resources release-info OK."

ciSteps.name: Verify deps.lock [sdl3-native] pin
ciSteps.run:
set -e
# SDL3 是唯一一个我们自己维护开发分支的依赖：它跟上游主线、没有 release tag
# 可 pin，只能靠 commit + base_commit 定位。这几个字段一旦空掉或退化成 PENDING，
# libSDL3.so 就变成"来源不明的二进制"，上游 PR 也失去可复现性凭据。
# 详见 prebuilt/sdl3/README.md 与 docs/adaptation/SDL3_MIGRATION_PLAN.md。
# 注意 sub(/\r$/,"")：deps.lock 是 CRLF，不剥 \r 的话取出来的值会带尾随回车，
# 后面的 ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ 之类格式校验会全部误报。（既有的 JDK 校验只查非空，
# \r 不影响非空判断，所以一直没暴露这个坑。）
read_lock_field() {
  awk -v key="$1" '
    /^\[sdl3-native\]/ { f=1; next }
    /^\[/ { f=0 }
    f && $1==key && $2=="=" { $1=""; $2=""; sub(/^[ \t]+/,""); sub(/[ \t]*#.*$/,""); sub(/\r$/,""); sub(/[ \t]+$/,""); print; exit }
  ' deps.lock
}
fail=0
# 三个 40-char SHA-1：我们的 HEAD / 上游基底 / ABI 闸门基线
for k in commit base_commit abi_base vendor_ref; do
  v=$(read_lock_field "$k")
  if [ -z "$v" ] || [ "$v" = "PENDING" ]; then
    echo "::error::deps.lock [sdl3-native].$k is empty or PENDING"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  elif ! printf '%s' "$v" | grep -qE '^[0-9a-f]{40}$'; then
    echo "::error::deps.lock [sdl3-native].$k is not a 40-char SHA-1: $v"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
done
# 产物 sha256
v=$(read_lock_field sha256)
if ! printf '%s' "$v" | grep -qE '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'; then
  echo "::error::deps.lock [sdl3-native].sha256 is not a 64-char hex digest: $v"
  fail=$((fail + 1))
fi
# 分支名与版本串
for k in branch version_string; do
  v=$(read_lock_field "$k")
  if [ -z "$v" ] || [ "$v" = "PENDING" ]; then
    echo "::error::deps.lock [sdl3-native].$k is empty or PENDING"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
  fi
done
# 版本串必须内嵌 commit 短哈希 —— 这是"产物真的由该 commit 编出"的直接凭据
c=$(read_lock_field commit)
vs=$(read_lock_field version_string)
if [ -n "$c" ] && [ -n "$vs" ]; then
  short=$(printf '%s' "$c" | cut -c1-9)
  case "$vs" in
    *"$short"*) : ;;
    *)
      echo "::error::[sdl3-native].version_string ($vs) does not contain commit prefix g$short — 产物与 pin 不匹配，说明换了产物却没更新 commit（或反之）"
      fail=$((fail + 1))
      ;;
  esac
fi
# upstream 必须是 libsdl-org：我们 fork 的是真源，不是别人的 fork
u=$(read_lock_field upstream)
case "$u" in
  *libsdl-org/SDL*) : ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::[sdl3-native].upstream should point at libsdl-org/SDL, got: $u"
    fail=$((fail + 1))
    ;;
esac
if [ $fail -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::$fail problem(s) in deps.lock [sdl3-native]"
  exit 1
fi
echo "deps.lock [sdl3-native] pin OK."

fail=0

    echo "::error file=$f::attribution marker '$marker' missing — 原作者署名不得移除（zlib 合规 + 上游信任）"

  echo "::error file=prebuilt/sdl3/README.md::missing attribution section"
  fail=$((fail + 1))
fi

ciSteps.name: Verify gitignored credentials are NOT committed
ciSteps.run:
set -e
# build-profile.json5（可能含签名 / 凭据）应被忽略
# Root build-profile.json5 contains signing material and must stay
# ignored. entry/build-profile.json5 is the non-secret tracked module
# target/device/source-root definition and is expected in source.
if git ls-files --error-unmatch build-profile.json5 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "::error::root build-profile.json5 should be gitignored (only .template is committed)"
  exit 1
fi
# *.p7b / *.p12 / *.cer 一律不能入库
bad=$(git ls-files '*.p7b' '*.p12' '*.cer' '*.pem' 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'rawfile/cacert.pem' || true)
if [ -n "$bad" ]; then
  echo "::error::credentials committed: $bad"
  exit 1
fi
echo "No credential leakage."
